_comment: Task 4 self-generated fine-tuning corpus (execution-validation smoke only —
NO quality claims). 12 original short utterances: 6 Chinese + 6 English.
Every text is distinct from tests/data/multilingual_samples.json.
Rendered to wav by scripts/make_finetune_dataset.py via the OFFICIAL
custom-voice model (self-generated speech only; no third-party audio),
with torch.manual_seed(1234) before each render and max_new_tokens=512.
The transcript rule: transcript == the manifest text used to generate.
'reference' is one extra self-generated clip used as the shared ref_audio
for all samples (upstream README: use the same ref_audio for all samples).
